purpose: Which image tool makes the best report pictures for Acolyte. Hand-made in the apps for now; the winner's API (via OpenRouter or direct) is used in production.

criteria.style: matches the house style: flat isometric, charcoal + lime palette (0-5)
criteria.sa: recognisably South African, believable people and places (0-5)
criteria.no_text: no letters, logos or garbled text anywhere (0-5)
criteria.space: clear empty side for a headline, 16:9 (0-5)
criteria.quality: no artefacts: hands, faces, warped objects (0-5)
